stories.title: BNP wins a landslide in Bangladesh's first post-Hasina election; Tarique Rahman becomes PM
stories.summary: The BNP won about 210 of 300 directly elected seats, and Jamaat-e-Islami became the main opposition for the first time. A referendum approved the 'July Charter' reforms by more than 60%. Rahman replaced Yunus's interim government on Feb 17.
